title: Data source research candidate
description: One evaluated candidate from the research-sources procedure (see .claude/skills/research-sources/SKILL.md). Written to research/candidates/<slug>.json.

slug.description: Filename-safe identifier, matches the JSON filename and the memo slug.

url.description: Canonical, official (non-third-party-mirror) URL for the dataset or API.

measures.description: What the series actually measures, in one sentence.

coverage.description: Geographic scope. 'national' is preferred per the project's US-wide goal.

history.description: How far back the series goes, e.g. '1971-present'.

license.description: License / terms of use, and whether there's any login wall or commercial-use restriction.

cost.description: Confirmation of free access and any rate limit.

verified.description: How the above fields were confirmed this run. 'fetched' = a live request succeeded against the official domain this session. 'search_only' = corroborated only via web search snippets/official docs pages, no live fetch (e.g. the domain was egress-blocked in this sandbox). 'unverified' = could not be confirmed at all.

verification_note.description: Free-text caveat, e.g. naming which domain was egress-blocked and why that's a sandbox policy, not a property of the source.

existing_overlap.description: Any existing source in backend/sources.yaml that already covers similar ground, and how this candidate differs.

correlation.description: Output of app/research/evaluate_series.py against FHFA tract HPI growth / Zillow ZORI, if that tool exists and was run. null if the tool doesn't exist yet (Phase 4 not built) or doesn't apply (e.g. a single national series that can't be correlated against per-neighborhood ranking).

recommend.description: true, false, or 'conditional' (worth adding later / under a specific condition, not now).
